description.text: Beginning Set+, released on 5 August 2011: a new version of the Black & White Beginning Set with the same cards, three ready-built 30-card half decks with a playmat, a coin and damage counters and markers, that came with the Nintendo DS software Pokémon Card Game Asobikata DS (how to play DS) instead of a DVD. The software taught the rules through a story with practice battles on the touch screen, battles against the computer with the set's decks, quizzes and a rule dictionary, and could be sent to a friend's DS by Download Play. Its cards carry this set's own code, HS+, rather than the Beginning Set's HS.
